_comment: Tuned oMLX recipe for Qwen 3.8 27B on 128 GB Apple Silicon: SpecPrefill (0.5B draft) + TurboQuant KV 6-bit + MTP. Measured 1467 PP tok/s @195k ctx, 30.4 TG tok/s, ~33 GB peak on M5 Max 40c 128GB (omlx.ai/benchmarks/performance/10p6ed74; that run used an AWQ-gs64-mm quant with no public repo, so lac stages oQ4e-mtp -- the settings are quant-independent). Merged into ~/.omlx/settings.json by `lac runtime start`; applies at server startup only.
